chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: Legal Center Overview
chunks.text: The Skyes Over London / SOL Enterprises public legal center lives at https://solenterprises.org/. It covers all legal, compliance, privacy, and terms documentation for the entire Skye ecosystem including Skyes Over London, SOL Enterprises, kAIxU, VANTA13, VantaCore, SkyeHands, Routex-style logistics tooling, creator/media workflows, commerce surfaces, and developer APIs. Contact: grayskyes@solenterprises.org. Governing law: Arizona, United States. Entity: Skyes Over London LC.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: Master Terms of Service
chunks.text: Master Terms of Service govern all access to Skyes Over London services including websites, applications, SaaS products, AI systems, automations, communication services, media, commerce, logistics, and developer tools. URL: https://solenterprises.org/legal/terms/. Governing law: Arizona. Entity: Skyes Over London LC. Services are provided as-is unless a signed agreement states otherwise. Liability is capped at amounts paid in the prior three months or one hundred dollars.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: Enterprise Privacy Policy
chunks.text: Privacy policy covers all personal information processed through websites, apps, forms, SMS, email, AI tools, SaaS products, client services, creator programs, commerce workflows, logistics, developer tools, and business operations. URL: https://solenterprises.org/legal/privacy/. SMS opt-in consent and phone numbers are not sold for third-party marketing. AI prompts and outputs may be processed by third-party model providers. California resident rights are addressed. Requests to grayskyes@solenterprises.org.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: AI Terms and Transparency
chunks.text: AI-specific terms covering AI system use, prompt handling, output accuracy, and transparency disclosures. URLs: https://solenterprises.org/legal/ai-terms/ and https://solenterprises.org/legal/ai-transparency/. AI outputs are not guaranteed to be accurate. Customers should not submit regulated or confidential data unless the plan allows. AI data use policy is part of the master privacy framework.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: SMS Communications and Consent
chunks.text: SMS communications policy and consent page for toll-free carrier verification. URL: https://solenterprises.org/legal/sms-communications/. SMS opt-in consent data is never sold or shared for third-party marketing. The contact and sms-consent paths serve as Twilio verification proof. Carriers require documented opt-in evidence for toll-free text messaging.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: DMCA and Intellectual Property
chunks.text: DMCA and IP policy covering takedown procedures and intellectual property protections for all Skye ecosystem properties. URL: https://solenterprises.org/legal/dmca-ip/. Contact grayskyes@solenterprises.org for IP notices. Covers creator, media, and commerce content workflows.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center

URLs: https://solenterprises.org/legal/enterprise-msa/ and https://solenterprises.org/legal/saas-platform/. Covers uptime, SLAs, service levels, data processing addendum, and enterprise scope. URL for SLA: https://solenterprises.org/legal/service-level/. Data processing addendum: https://solenterprises.org/legal/data-processing-addendum/.

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center

chunks.title: Skyes Over London Legal Center
chunks.heading: Legal Sync — How to Update Brain
chunks.text: To sync updated legal information into the MetrAIyux 0S brain: edit brain/legal-sync.json and update the chunks with current legal policy summaries and URLs. The brain loads this file automatically alongside knowledge-base.json. When policies change at https://solenterprises.org/, update the matching chunk text in legal-sync.json. The brain keyword legal triggers a +5 boost score, so legal queries will surface this content first. Compliance routing always runs through Julian Mercer (Legal & Compliance Cabinet).
